photo_title: Star Trek Beyond Japan Premiere Red Carpet: J. J. Abrams & Simon Pegg
alt_text: J. J. Abrams and Simon Pegg at a Star Trek Beyond premiere backdrop; Pegg holds a handheld microphone.
